concerns.text: T002 is tagged [P] but its verification runs `pytest tests/contract/test_dataset_schema.py`, which validates against `contracts/materials_dataset.schema.yaml` created in T001. T002 is a consumer of T001's artifact, so the [P] tag is unsafe — either drop [P] from T002 or note it is parallel-safe only after T001.

T005 is tagged [P], yet the Execution-order section itself states "T005's training loop depends on T003's graphs". A task with a declared intra-phase dependency on T003 cannot be parallel-safe; remove the [P] tag or split the model-definition portion from the training loop.
